# SC-PII-2026-09-10 — Fictional contact details

**Decision owner:** Priya (U006), Team Lead  
**Issued and effective:** September 10, 2026, 09:00 America/New_York  
**Scope:** Safety Classification project; the fictional-contact branch of QN handling.

## Clarification
Clearly fictional placeholder phone numbers or email addresses alone do not require QN when the surrounding evidence establishes that no real individual is identifiable.

If contact details could identify a real person, the fictional context is uncertain, or another required safety trigger applies, retain the task for review under the applicable rules. This clarification does not waive those separate controls.

## Superseded wording
This replaces the blanket initial-quarantine requirement for fictional contact details in the **Contact details** section of [QN help page v1.0](../../instructions/history/safety_qn_help_page_v1.0.md). It does not invalidate unrelated controls in that page.

# RP-20260916-01 — Approve tie calibration advice

## Context
The prior batch's calibration packet contained one pair differing only in wording and another in which one response omitted a fact needed for the user's request. Reviewers were using “slightly clearer” without explaining whether it changed usefulness.

## Suggested advice
The simulated Advisor proposed a brief alignment announcement and a review of eight sampled pairs, using the existing meaningful-quality-difference criterion.

## TL approval
Alex approved the proposal. Ask reviewers to identify the actual user-facing benefit; a cosmetic wording preference alone is not sufficient. Keep material accuracy or instruction defects visible rather than forcing ties.

This is a calibration of the existing criterion, not a new numerical preference threshold. The approval covers the batch-14 exercise.

## State
Posting and the review exercise are authorized but not recorded as completed in this approval.
